name: Browser drag
description: Drags from a source element or point to a target element or point in the visible in-app browser.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 在用户眼前可见的内嵌浏览器中，从源元素/坐标拖到目标元素/坐标（滑块、排序、画布平移）。不做 HTML5 文件拖入。
localizedDescription.en-US: Drags from a source element or point to a target element or point in the visible in-app browser (sliders, reorder, canvas pan). Does not perform HTML5 file drop.

fromSelector.description: CSS selector of the drag source. Supports optional frame:N prefix.

fromX.description: Viewport X of the drag source (used when fromSelector is omitted).

fromY.description: Viewport Y of the drag source (used when fromSelector is omitted).

toSelector.description: CSS selector of the drag target. Supports optional frame:N prefix.

toX.description: Viewport X of the drag target (used when toSelector is omitted).

toY.description: Viewport Y of the drag target (used when toSelector is omitted).
